verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents saved/reused logged-in browser profiles and a workflow where a run pauses at a 2FA screen so a human can enter the code via a live-view URL, keeping the secret out of the model's context (browser-use-docs-10, browser-use-docs-11). However there is no documented credential vault, encrypted secret storage, or automated TOTP code generation/injection — 2FA still requires a human to manually type the code each time, not a stored-secret automated flow. Missing for 10: a credential vault/secrets manager integration, automated TOTP code generation, and evidence of fully unattended 2FA completion without human entry.
